name: Logbook
description: A logbook in the Kainos look: callsign lookup as you type (country, zones, beam heading, QRZ / HamQTH / callook), worked-before by band and mode, QSOs from VFO A and from the FT8 and SSTV modules, ADIF import and export. Uploads to LoTW (through TQSL), eQSL, QRZ Logbook and Club Log, with confirmations brought back. POTA: activators on the air (click to tune), activations with the files pota.app wants, and spotting yourself. Contests: 37 of them, with the exchange, dupes, mults, the score, Cabrillo, and Enter / F1 - F3 sending CQ, the exchange and TU (CW, or the Voice Keyer on phone; Kainos 1.0.15). Awards: DXCC, WAS, WAZ and grids, worked and confirmed.
author: Justin Cron K7JUS
